QuestInfo.name: Thief of the Shade
QuestInfo.0: You followed the Thief you met in Kerning City and arrived in the back alley. What exactly is this 'Secret Garden'?
QuestInfo.1: Ryden suggested you become a Thief of the Secret Garden. Go meet Lady Syl, their leader.
QuestInfo.2: You met Lady Syl, the leader of the Secret Garden.

1.0: Hm. We haven't met. I'm Lady Syl, and you may call me... Lady Syl. You're not the one I would've picked for this job, but Ryden recommended you, so we'll see.

npc.0: You should go speak with Lady Syl.
